privacy.seoDescription: Max-Morrys privacy policy and protection of personal data (GDPR).
privacy.title: Privacy policy

intro.heading: Introduction
intro.p1: This privacy policy describes how <1>MY ONOMA SARL</1>, the company operating the Max-Morrys brand, collects, uses and protects your personal data when you use our website and services.
intro.p2: We are committed to complying with Senegalese law no. 2008-12 of 25 January 2008 on the protection of personal data, as well as the GDPR for European users.

collected.heading: Data collected
collected.item1: Identification data: surname, first name, email address
collected.item2: Connection data: IP address, browsing data
collected.item3: Purchase-related data: order history, payment methods
collected.item4: Progress data: progress within the courses
collected.item5: Communication data: messages sent via the contact form
collected.item6: Data related to the Rysmo AI assistant: history of your conversations with Rysmo, a derived learning profile (topics of interest, estimated level, areas to strengthen), and content engagement data (views, reading time, scrolling, audio/video progress), stored server-side to personalize its guidance
collected.note: Rysmo's memory is <1>enabled by default</1>. You can disable it and erase it at any time from your account (<3>Account → Rysmo → Memory</3>).

purposes.heading: Purposes of processing
purposes.item2: Access to and tracking of your courses
purposes.item5: Improving our services and the user experience
purposes.item7: Educational personalization of the Rysmo AI assistant (legal basis: legitimate interest, with your control — disable and erase at any time)

retention.heading: Retention period
retention.intro: Your data is kept for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected:
retention.item1: Account data: for the duration of your registration + 3 years
retention.item4: Rysmo assistant memory: kept for as long as the memory is enabled; erasable at any time from your account

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.intro: In accordance with applicable law, you have the following rights:
rights.contact: To exercise these rights, contact us at: contact@maxmorrys.me

processors.heading: Sub-processors
processors.intro: We rely on the following sub-processors to operate our services:
processors.item1: Firebase / Google Cloud (Google LLC) — Hosting, database and authentication
processors.item2: Bictorys — Payment processing (Wave, Orange Money, Free Money, bank card)
processors.item3: Google Generative AI (Gemini) — Rysmo educational assistant (processing of conversations to generate responses; the history is stored on Max-Morrys servers for personalized memory)

cgv.seoDescription: Terms and Conditions of Sale for Max-Morrys courses and services.
cgv.title: Terms and Conditions of Sale

art1.heading: Article 1 — Purpose
art1.body: These Terms and Conditions of Sale (T&Cs) govern the contractual relationship between <1>MY ONOMA SARL</1> (hereinafter "the Publisher") and any individual or legal entity (hereinafter "the Customer") wishing to access the online courses and services offered on the Max-Morrys platform.

art2.heading: Article 2 — Identification of the Publisher
art2.intro: The Max-Morrys platform is operated by:

art3.heading: Article 3 — Description of services
art3.intro: Under the brand operated by MY ONOMA SARL, Max-Morrys offers:
art3.item1: <1>Online courses</1> on digital marketing, SEO and artificial intelligence, accessible for life after purchase (videos, written content, quizzes, practical assignments, downloadable resources).
art3.item2: <1>Certificates of completion</1> issued upon 100% completion of a course, publicly verifiable via a unique code.
art3.item3: <1>Rysmo</1>, an educational assistant powered by artificial intelligence, available to enrolled learners.
art3.item4: <1>Club des Digitos</1>, a paid private community on an annual subscription (19,900 FCFA / year), giving access to a news feed, discussions, live sessions, events and exclusive content.
art3.item5: <1>Live sessions and events</1> reserved for members of the Club des Digitos.
art3.item6: <1>Free content</1>: blog articles, podcasts and videos accessible to all.

art4.heading: Article 4 — Ordering and account creation
art4.p1: To access the courses, the Customer must create a user account. They undertake to provide accurate information and keep it up to date. Access to the content is strictly personal and may not be shared, assigned or transferred to a third party, under penalty of immediate termination of the account.
art4.p2: Validating an order implies full and unreserved acceptance of these T&Cs. The Customer acknowledges having read the T&Cs and having accepted them via a dedicated checkbox before completing the payment.

art5.heading: Article 5 — Pricing and payment terms
art5.sub51Body: Prices are stated in CFA Francs (XOF), excluding tax. Senegalese VAT at the rate in force is added to the displayed price where it is due; the total amount including tax is shown before the order is confirmed. The applicable price is the one displayed at the time of the order. Promotions and discount coupons may be offered occasionally. Active members of the Digitos Club receive a standing 20% discount on course purchases; this discount does not stack with a coupon — whichever is more favourable is applied.
art5.sub52Body: Payment is made via <1>Bictorys</1>, a payment aggregator integrating Wave, Orange Money, Free Money and bank cards (Visa / Mastercard). The transaction is secured and encrypted by the payment provider.
art5.sub53Body: The Customer acknowledges that the transaction will be recorded under the trade name of the parent company, <1>MY ONOMA</1>. An invoice is automatically sent by email in the name of MY ONOMA SARL as soon as payment is confirmed.
art5.sub54Body: The subscription to the Club des Digitos is entered into for a period of twelve (12) months from the date of payment.
art5.sub54Item1: On activation, the Client chooses whether to receive a <1>reminder before the term ends</1>. There is <3>no automatic renewal</3>: no amount is ever charged without a new action by the Client.
art5.sub54Item2: If the Client asked for the reminder, MY ONOMA SARL notifies them by email at least fifteen (15) days before the term ends. The Client may turn this reminder on or off at any time from their student area. When the term ends, access stops with no further formality.
art5.sub54Item3: No pro rata refund is made in the event of cancellation during the subscription period.

art6.heading: Article 6 — Right of withdrawal and refund
art6.intro: In accordance with the practices of digital commerce for intangible content:
art6.item1: The Customer agrees that performance of the service begins immediately after payment.
art6.item2: Consequently, as soon as the Customer has accessed the course content (watching a video or downloading a document), they <1>expressly waive their right of withdrawal</1>.
art6.item3: No refund will be issued once access to the courses has been activated, except in the event of a major technical failure of the platform preventing lasting access to the content.

art7.heading: Article 7 — Intellectual property
art7.p1: All content (videos, texts, graphics, PDF materials, templates, etc.) on the Max-Morrys platform is the exclusive property of MY ONOMA SARL or Max-Morrys.
art7.p2: Any reproduction, distribution, modification or commercial use of all or part of the content without prior written authorization is strictly prohibited and may give rise to legal proceedings.

art8.heading: Article 8 — Liability
art8.p1: The Publisher makes every effort to ensure the platform is available 24/7. However, it cannot be held liable for interruptions related to maintenance, problems with the Customer's internet connection, or cases of force majeure.
art8.p2: The courses are advisory and educational tools; the Publisher cannot guarantee specific financial or commercial results following their completion. The results obtained depend on the Customer's personal commitment and application.

art9.heading: Article 9 — Protection of personal data
art9.p1: The data collected is necessary for order management, access to services and educational tracking. In accordance with Senegalese law no. 2008-12 of 25 January 2008 on the protection of personal data, the Customer has the right to access, rectify, object to and delete the data concerning them.
art9.p2: To exercise these rights, the Customer may contact the Publisher at <1>contact@maxmorrys.me</1>. For more details, see our <3>privacy policy</3>.

art10.heading: Article 10 — Governing law and disputes
art10.body: These T&Cs are governed by Senegalese law and OHADA standards. In the event of a dispute, an amicable solution will be sought before any legal action. Failing this, the courts of Dakar shall have sole jurisdiction.

cgu.seoDescription: General terms of use of the Max-Morrys platform and the Rysmo AI assistant.
cgu.title: Terms of use

art1.heading: 1. Purpose
art1.body: These general terms of use (ToU) govern access to and use of the Max-Morrys platform, operated by <1>MY ONOMA SARL</1>. By creating an account or using the service, you accept these terms.

art2.heading: 2. Account & access
art2.body: Access to certain features requires the creation of an account. You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for the activity carried out from your account. The information provided must be accurate and kept up to date.

art3.heading: 3. Acceptable use
art3.intro: You undertake to use the platform fairly. The following are notably prohibited:
art3.item1: sharing your access or reselling course content;
art3.item2: any attempt to circumvent protections or security;
art3.item3: using the service for illegal, deceptive or harmful purposes.

art4.heading: 4. Intellectual property
art4.body: The content (courses, articles, podcasts, videos, trademarks, logos) is the property of Max-Morrys or its partners and is protected. Your access grants you a personal, non-exclusive right of use, with no right of reproduction or distribution.

art5.heading: 5. Rysmo AI assistant
art5.intro: Rysmo is an educational assistant powered by artificial intelligence (Google Gemini). You acknowledge and accept the following points:
art5.item1: Rysmo's responses are <1>provided for guidance only</1> and may contain errors or inaccuracies. They do not constitute guaranteed professional advice; verify important information.
art5.item2: To personalize its guidance, Rysmo <1>remembers your conversations</1> and takes into account your <3>content consultation activity</3> (articles read, time spent, progress on audio/video) in order to identify your goals, interests and progress. This memory is <5>enabled by default</5>.
art5.item3: You can at any time <1>disable</1> this memory and <3>erase</3> the associated data from your account: <5>Account → Rysmo → Memory</5>.
art5.item4: Details of the data processed, its purpose, its retention period and your rights can be found in our <1>Privacy policy</1>.

art6.heading: 6. Liability
art6.body: Max-Morrys makes every effort to ensure the availability and quality of the service, with no guarantee that it will be entirely free of interruptions or errors. Max-Morrys cannot be held liable for decisions made solely on the basis of the AI assistant's responses.

art7.heading: 7. Changes to the ToU
art7.body: These terms may change. In the event of a substantial change, you will be informed. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

art8.heading: 8. Governing law
art8.body: These ToU are governed by Senegalese law, in compliance with the GDPR for users in the European Union. Any dispute falls under the jurisdiction of the competent courts.

cookies.seoDescription: Policy for managing cookies and trackers on the Max-Morrys website.
cookies.title: Cookie policy

what.heading: What is a cookie?
what.p1: A cookie is a small text file placed on your device (computer, tablet, smartphone) when you visit a website. It allows the site to recognize your browser and store certain information.
what.p2: The Max-Morrys website, operated by <1>MY ONOMA SARL</1>, uses cookies and similar technologies (browser local storage) to ensure the service works and to improve your experience.

types.heading: Types of cookies used
types.essentialBody: Necessary for the website to function. They enable navigation, authentication and security. They do not require your consent.
types.analyticsBody: Used to understand how visitors interact with the site. These cookies are only enabled after your consent.
types.marketingBody: Used to display relevant content. Enabled only with your consent.

preferences.heading: Managing your preferences
preferences.p1: On your first visit, a banner lets you choose which categories of cookies you accept. You can change your preferences at any time by clicking the "Manage cookies" link at the bottom of the page.
preferences.p2: You can also configure your browser to refuse cookies. Note that some features of the site may then no longer work correctly.

retention.heading: Retention period
retention.body: Cookies are kept for a maximum period of 13 months. After that, your consent will be requested again.

legal.item3: The CNIL's recommendations on cookies and trackers
